_about: ING1 registry (docs/ING1_INGESTION_AND_STAGE_REGISTRY.md section 3.1): the one place a dataset name is listed. Paths are relative to the workspace root unless they start with ~ or $; the first candidate whose record file exists is the package.

encoder_policy.rule: Every first stage, seed, flat list, question vector and node row of the main line comes from the defined encoder. The comparison encoder (frozen) is read only by a module listed in configs/legacy_encoder_modules.json with its reason; its numbers are labelled older-encoder reads. Checked by scripts/ingest/encoder_policy.py and tests/test_encoder_policy.py (docs/ING1_INGESTION_AND_STAGE_REGISTRY.md amendment 2).
